parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: This is the flush button of the toilet, typically made of durable plastic and located on the top of the tank.
parts.Functional_description: It activates the flushing mechanism, releasing water from the tank into the bowl to clean it.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of the toilet seat, made of smooth plastic and hinged to the base body.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the toilet bowl when not in use, providing hygiene and aesthetic appeal.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the hinge axis to open or close over the seat.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the toilet, made of glazed ceramic, forming the bowl and tank structure.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the user, holds water, and channels waste to the drainage system.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving structural component anchored to the floor.
